output.reason: [ev-85eccdc718e3] and [ev-2941a875a468] describe a new optional upgrade path: users who used `kubectl apply` "can continue to do so" and "can begin safely upgrading" with `helm upgrade istio-base`. No operator step is mandatory, so the change is not migration-required, and the migration family (which only allows migration-required) is the wrong subject. The underlying chart change is CRDs templated by default, with `Values.base.enableCRDTemplates` deprecated [ev-fa194382072a]. That is a separate release-note item on a different subject, which this text does not name, so no corrected assertion follows from this item.
